source_snapshot.items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Locate
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert NVMe SSD, select its NVMe adapter, invoke locate and check the Locate LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: LED behavior matches the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL offers generic controller/raw IPMI commands without authoritative selectors or target/non-target proof.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires literal NVMe Locate/UID semantics, stable mapping, pinned start/readback/clear syntax and physical evidence.

old_problem: SAS/SATA taxonomy obscured the explicit NVMe Locate procedure, and generic/raw commands could illuminate the wrong bay or leave stale service state without proving the physical target.
disposition_reason: The Items suffix and three Procedure steps unambiguously define NVMe Locate/UID; SAS/SATA is legacy grouping. The exact OEM command, selector, LED cadence and topology are required runtime project bindings, not a remaining review decision. Physical target and non-target observation plus clear/readback remain mandatory.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row117 all18 XLSX cells and history2725.
Preserved insertion, exact-adapter selection, Locate start, physical observation and explicit clear/readback.
Rejected guessed raw IPMI and command-return-only evidence; no hardware, LED or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized per-NVMe Locate/UID LED target-and-clear validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the supported Locate/UID command for each exact mapped NVMe SSD illuminates only the intended physical bay with the OEM-defined pattern and returns it to idle when cleared.
required_package: Vendor-approved target-specific Locate start/status/clear syntax and tool version
OEM Locate/UID and idle LED color/cadence/timing specification
Qualified operator, supported insertion method and timestamped target/non-target video
Command timeout, cleanup verification, abort limits and restoration policy
test_case.test_command: After approved insertion and stable mapping, invoke the vendor-supported Locate start command for exactly one SSD selector, read back state, record the intended bay and adjacent non-target bays, then clear Locate on the same selector and prove readback plus physical return to idle. Do not use guessed selectors or undocumented raw IPMI.
test_case.expected_result: Only the mapped bay displays the OEM-specified Locate/UID pattern within the allowed latency, adjacent bays remain unchanged, and the same target returns to its documented idle state after clear with no storage/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires stable identity, successful target-specific start/readback/clear, timestamped physical target and non-target evidence, and final idle proof. Command exit zero alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Pin stable SSD and enclosure identities; never rely on /dev/nvme enumeration alone.
Physical insertion is qualified-operator work under approved power/hot-swap and ESD procedure.
Use only documented vendor Locate syntax and clear the same exact target.
Abort on wrong-bay illumination, selector drift, uncleared state, device loss or storage/BMC error; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Vendor command/version and OEM Locate/idle LED matrix
Timestamped target and adjacent non-target photos/video
Final readback, idle LED, topology, health and OS/BMC logs
test_case.recovery: Issue only the documented clear on the same stable selector, verify readback and physical idle, and preserve evidence. If clear fails or the wrong bay illuminates, stop all further service commands and escalate to the storage/backplane owner; do not guess another raw command.

source_conflict.reason: Explicit NVMe adapter/SSD Procedure defines the target; SAS/SATA is legacy taxonomy rather than an alternate Locate requirement.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; vendor syntax, topology, OEM LED table and operator bind execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind stable per-drive topology, approved Locate syntax, OEM LED matrix, operator and cleanup policy.
pending.owner: NVMe/backplane/storage management owner and qualified operator.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; missing vendor/project bindings prevent execution or PASS.

project_authority: OEM command selectors and physical LED semantics are project-controlled inputs and may not be guessed.
